text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 31, 2024) for 297 Woodfield Road

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Amended the location of the walkway in Section 1 of the Property Standards Order (October 31, 2024) for 297 Woodfield Road, Folder Number 4 233485 PRS 00 IV to "south". 2. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 31, 2024) for 297 Woodfield Road, Folder Number 4 233485 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to February 27, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
